objective: Add an Admin-maintained current business ERP baseline and authoritative recency projection, then present separate stable-color Retailer and Distributor ERP donut intelligence without rewriting visit history.

humanGate.reason: Only the Owner may manually apply Migration 049 after exact-head controller certification.

budgets.dataAuthority: public.field_business_erp_baselines owns only Admin-supplied current ERP enrichment; public.field_visits remains historical observation authority, public.erp_systems remains the canonical ERP dictionary, and distributor_accounts.erp_id remains official Distributor ERP assignment.
budgets.readBudget: One bounded service read returns at most 500 exact visited businesses and one bounded V2 current-footprint aggregate; no per-row ERP reads.
budgets.writeBudget: One Admin-only service RPC validates and atomically applies at most 500 baseline set/None/clear operations without changing visits or other authorities.
budgets.rlsModel: RLS enabled; anon/authenticated direct DML denied; browser uses Admin-authorized server boundaries and service credentials remain server-only.
budgets.indexRequirements: Use only keys/indexes required by the primary key and measured current-footprint query; no speculative indexes.
budgets.failureMode: Invalid identity, capability, ERP input, or batch size rejects safely with no partial mutation; UI retains unsaved edits and reports safe row errors.
budgets.concurrencyModel: Complete batch validation precedes one transaction; exact (segment_type,business_ref) identity and canonical erp_key resolution prevent fuzzy or duplicate authority.
budgets.idempotencyModel: Repeated identical set/None operations converge on one baseline row; clear affects only that exact manual baseline; canonical ERP normalization reuses one ERP identity.
budgets.testPlan: Focused migration/RPC/V2 projection, authorization, Admin UI, donut integrity/color, Graph, typecheck and E2E tests followed by exact-head GitHub PostgreSQL 17/full CI and Vercel preview.

acceptance.description: Migration 049 adds the zero-backfill manual current ERP baseline authority, atomic Admin batch RPC, and V2 recency/provenance projection while preserving all prior migrations and authorities. Controller repair: erp_usage_state must permit (NULL,NULL), only captured visit states erp/none may compete with Admin baselines as valid ERP facts, and the public RPC argument contract must be p_actor_id plus p_rows.

Admin Visits ERP Intelligence provides bounded exact-business search/filter and multi-row current ERP editing with existing/custom/None/clear behavior and safe refresh/error handling. Controller repair: include business display name when an exact UUID lead exists, Type, Latest visit, Source, Last updated, required state filters and text search, and reuse SearchableSelect for existing/custom/None/clear editing. Exact UI contract: expose a Manage Current ERP opener, label sources Field Visit/Admin/Not captured, offer All/Retailers/Distributors and All states/Not captured/ERP assigned/None filters, and label the batch CTA Save N changes.

Retailer and Distributor current ERP footprints render as two accessible reconciled donuts with stable cross-chart ERP colors and distinct None/Not captured semantics. Controller repair: donut centers must label their totals Retailers and Distributors respectively.
Authority boundaries, security, compatibility, and MANUAL_BASELINE_NOT_HISTORY_RULE are registered and compiled without expanding worker context.

Focused high-value proof plus exact-head Graph v1.3.1 GitHub CI, disposable PostgreSQL 17 Migration 049 verification, required E2E, and Vercel preview pass. The focused editor E2E passes with output outside the worktree. The disposable DB matrix must explicitly prove existing ERP, custom ERP, None, clear, non-admin and ERP Partner denial, direct authenticated denial, batch max, invalid all-or-nothing, both recency directions, None vs Not captured, repeat-business uniqueness, segment separation, reconciliation, and no cross-authority mutation.
Owner manually applies Migration 049 and supplies durable read-only production certification.
